extracted.summary: Google PhD Fellowship India Program is an opportunity offered by Google to support promising Ph.D. candidates of all backgrounds who seek to influence the future of technology.
extracted.amount_text: Early-stage PhD candidates receive an up to 4 year fellowship with USD 50,000 plus a Google research mentor. Late-stage PhD candidates receive a 1 year fellowship with USD 10,000 plus a Google research mentor.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be enrolled full-time in the Ph.D. program.
extracted.deadline_quote: 30th April 2026. The status shown on the page is Closed.
